Name: Configurable Giant Crops
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
This is just a small mod I created for testing giant crops in a [i]different[/i] mod I'm working on, but I thought others might find it useful.

There are 2 features:

[b]Chance of Giant Crops[/b]
[list]
[*]This can be configured separately for each of the 5 vanilla crops that can grow into giant crops
[*]The options are 0%, 1% (vanilla chance), 3% (default setting), 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 100%
[/list][b]Additional Locations for Giant Crops
[/b][list]
[*]Giant crops can be enabled in the Greenhouse and/or Ginger Island Farm
[/list]I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily change the config settings.

[b]
COMPATIBILITY[/b]

[list]
[*]Only for Stardew 1.6
[*]Does not affect the chance of giant crops added by other mods, but allows them to grow in the Greenhouse & ﻿Ginger Island Farm
[*]Should work with (most) modded greenhouses
[/list][b]
MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
